coaching_notes: Just so you know 3 of these losses is equal to one of our profit so happily accept the losses and move on.
This is why I live using small target with small stop loss ... even though our targets are small, we can keep trailing our profits .. but when it hits our stop loss, we loose very little
Which means with using this risk to reward ratio, in order to actually loose money your win rates needs to be below 25%

forget the win rate, The reason an extremely simple strategy like this works wonderfully is cause, it's so simple, there's no confusion and that allows you to focus on more important aspects like risk to reward and your trading psychology.

This strategy is best suited for those struggling with a strategy with too many complicated variables or price action where it's always hiting your stop loss ... forget about all those, often at times the simple strategies are what works the best
